scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compare input access patterns for per-record sums under AoS and SoA layouts.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: 4096 independent sums of 4096 signed Int32 payloads with explicit UInt32 wrap semantics.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 4096 records by 4096 fields, two physical memory layouts. No physical simulation topology.
invariants: Each layout represents identical logical values.
Outputs equal full scalar modulo-2^32 sums.
accuracy_requirements: Exact 4096 Int32 outputs for each layout; actual input reads are part of the required work.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Integer wrapping and byte strides, not floating-point accuracy.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Two 64 MiB input layouts, 4096x4096; ten repeats.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Synthetic coalescing/layout proxy; AppleTree struct names do not establish an agricultural science application.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No application domain is evidenced beyond generic memory-layout performance.
scientific_intent.review_phase: retrospective source annotation, no new GPU runs
